scope: Post-cleanup reseal and calibrated-runner/grading wiring validation. No live model/provider connectivity check.
changes: Calibrated runner requires a matching experiment seal and repetition 1..3 before credentials; compares actual model, budget, instructions, source and backend binding before first provider request.
Seal is revalidated before every case and after the batch; seal hash is also frozen against replacement.
Each trial records its repetition-scoped identity; HTTP attempt and response journals remain distinct.
Predeclared calibrated rubrics can be reviewed with strict host annotations and aggregated; no inference of semantic pass from host status.
Legacy post-hoc review remains supported; host timeout maps to wall budget; calibrated native output exhaustion remains a resource-limited trial, not an artificial evaluator-cap exclusion.

validation.mock_test_interpretation: Real Coder/Harness and Go serialization with mocked HTTP and fixture document sources; intentionally failing decisions all remain non-passing, no semantic capability claim.
checks: Missing or stale seal rejected before credential access.
Actual wire request has no evaluator-added max_tokens/max_completion_tokens; document tools present and run_command absent.
Calibrated batch outputs flow through predeclared host review with all HTTP counts and trial identities retained.
Real local RAG binding and both full official source paragraphs verified without ranking.
Existing legacy report raw SHA-256 unchanged and reconstructed JSON identical.
Ruff check/format and offline uv lock check passed.

remaining: Obtain explicit approval before executing the 24-trial batch; preflight/seal does not grant execution authority.
Provider credentials/connectivity and model behavior are not validated by this zero-call preflight.
After actual trials, supply host semantic annotations using review_kind=predeclared_rubric_host_review; do not auto-grade language claims or replace failed trials.
